mapper.sql: b.business_id, b.name, b.address, b.city, b.state, b.postal_code, b.stars, b.review_count, b.is_open, b.categories
mapper.select: SELECT , CAST(price.attribute_value AS UNSIGNED) as price_range, CASE WHEN delivery.attribute_value = 'True' THEN true ELSE false END as has_delivery, CASE WHEN takeout.attribute_value = 'True' THEN true ELSE false END as has_take_out, CASE WHEN outdoor.attribute_value = 'True' THEN true ELSE false END as has_outdoor_seating, CASE WHEN kids.attribute_value = 'True' THEN true ELSE false END as good_for_kids, (b.stars * 0.6 + LEAST(b.review_count / 10.0, 4) * 0.4) as popularity_score FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN business_attributes price ON b.business_id = price.business_id AND price.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsPriceRange2' LEFT JOIN business_attributes delivery ON b.business_id = delivery.business_id AND delivery.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsDelivery' LEFT JOIN business_attributes takeout ON b.business_id = takeout.business_id AND takeout.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsTakeOut' LEFT JOIN business_attributes outdoor ON b.business_id = outdoor.business_id AND outdoor.attribute_name = 'OutdoorSeating' LEFT JOIN business_attributes kids ON b.business_id = kids.business_id AND kids.attribute_name = 'GoodForKids' WHERE b.is_open = true ORDER BY popularity_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , CAST(price.attribute_value AS UNSIGNED) as price_range, null as has_delivery, null as has_take_out, null as has_outdoor_seating, null as good_for_kids, (b.stars * 0.6 + LEAST(b.review_count / 10.0, 4) * 0.4) as popularity_score FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN business_attributes price ON b.business_id = price.business_id AND price.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsPriceRange2' WHERE b.stars >= #{minStars} AND b.is_open = true ORDER BY b.stars DESC, b.review_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , CAST(price.attribute_value AS UNSIGNED) as price_range, CASE WHEN delivery.attribute_value = 'True' THEN true ELSE false END as has_delivery, CASE WHEN takeout.attribute_value = 'True' THEN true ELSE false END as has_take_out, null as has_outdoor_seating, null as good_for_kids, (b.stars / CAST(price.attribute_value AS DECIMAL(2,1))) as popularity_score FROM businesses b INNER JOIN business_attributes price ON b.business_id = price.business_id AND price.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsPriceRange2' AND price.attribute_value IN ('1', '2') LEFT JOIN business_attributes delivery ON b.business_id = delivery.business_id AND delivery.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsDelivery' LEFT JOIN business_attributes takeout ON b.business_id = takeout.business_id AND takeout.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsTakeOut' WHERE b.stars >= 4.0 AND b.is_open = true ORDER BY (b.stars / CAST(price.attribute_value AS DECIMAL(2,1))) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , CAST(price.attribute_value AS UNSIGNED) as price_range, null as has_delivery, null as has_take_out, null as has_outdoor_seating, true as good_for_kids, (b.stars * 0.6 + LEAST(b.review_count / 10.0, 4) * 0.4) as popularity_score FROM businesses b INNER JOIN business_attributes kids ON b.business_id = kids.business_id AND kids.attribute_name = 'GoodForKids' AND kids.attribute_value = 'True' LEFT JOIN business_attributes price ON b.business_id = price.business_id AND price.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsPriceRange2' WHERE b.is_open = true ORDER BY b.stars DESC, b.review_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , CAST(price.attribute_value AS UNSIGNED) as price_range, null as has_delivery, null as has_take_out, null as has_outdoor_seating, null as good_for_kids, (b.stars * 0.6 + LEAST(b.review_count / 10.0, 4) * 0.4) as popularity_score FROM businesses b INNER JOIN business_attributes price ON b.business_id = price.business_id AND price.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsPriceRange2' AND price.attribute_value IN ('3', '4') WHERE b.stars >= 4.0 AND b.is_open = true ORDER BY b.stars DESC, price.attribute_value DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , CAST(price.attribute_value AS UNSIGNED) as price_range, null as has_delivery, null as has_take_out, null as has_outdoor_seating, null as good_for_kids, (b.stars * 0.6 + LEAST(b.review_count / 10.0, 4) * 0.4) as popularity_score FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN business_attributes price ON b.business_id = price.business_id AND price.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsPriceRange2' WHERE b.categories LIKE CONCAT('%', #{category}, '%') ORDER BY b.stars DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , CAST(price.attribute_value AS UNSIGNED) as price_range, null as has_delivery, null as has_take_out, null as has_outdoor_seating, null as good_for_kids, (b.stars * 0.6 + LEAST(b.review_count / 10.0, 4) * 0.4) as popularity_score, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(b.latitude)) * cos(radians(b.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(b.latitude)))) AS distance FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN business_attributes price ON b.business_id = price.business_id AND price.attribute_name = 'RestaurantsPriceRange2' HAVING distance <= #{radiusKm} ORDER BY distance LIMIT #{limit}
